g.text: Three fixed genomes · four declared worlds · 256 shared seeds per world
Dots are means; whiskers are ±3 SE across lives. Intervals are descriptive, not simultaneous confidence bounds.
All lineage roles and worlds are shown. These revealed cases are development data; POOL changes several physical settings.
Fitness retains guard and extinction charges. Physical expenditure is shown as a positive cost. No circuit or memory claim.
